title: Qualify the geometry child without admitting it as a parent
hypothesis: The geometry child changes the controller's fitting basin enough to retain its advantage across fitting seeds, making it a credible qualification candidate rather than a single-fit exception.

prediction.against: simple_damped_push, identically refitted in every replicate
prediction.rationale: A five-point advantage averaged across fitting replicates would justify qualification consideration; unlike D-004, this tests fitting robustness and bank eligibility, not screen size. Requires per-idea GPU approval; stop the remote box afterward.

code_changes: scripts/compare_child_vs_parent.py (--research-protocol seed-robustness: child and parent refitted under five fit seeds on fixed demonstrations, probe s2905, confirmation s2906; seed-level and placement-level intervals; report-only qualification check for the child; no bank-role change)

falsified_by: A paired 95% interval upper bound below +0.05 refutes the predicted margin; an interval containing zero is inconclusive. Qualification additionally requires the unchanged qualification criteria and a strictly positive paired t-interval lower bound on development cases 10-39; ties cannot qualify.

approval.note: approved by advisor gpt-6.1-sol (consult call_00012, 'revise' with changes applied) under the user's 2026-10-22 session delegation

controls.note: control is simple_damped_push refitted identically under each of the five seeds; the metric is already child minus parent

result.notes: gen0_cand5_a0 (LLM geometry-scope mutation) vs simple_damped_push, refitted under fit seeds 2900-2904 on fixed demonstrations (split seed 0, as in the run), checkpoints 0/500/1000 selected on probe s2905; scored on 50 fresh confirmation cases s2906. Child 1.00 under every seed; parent 0.88-0.92. Placement-level child minus parent +0.104 [+0.023, +0.185] (wide because the parent's failures sit on a few placements); seed-level +0.104 [+0.083, +0.125], 5/0/0. Report only: the child scores 0.00 at its declared values and 1.00 fitted in all five seeds, so it meets the unchanged qualification rule (improves in >= 3 of 5, worst >= -0.05, mean > 0); no seed_bank.json or structure_roles.yaml change was made. Deviation: the promotion-case (10:40) scoring in the proposal was replaced by step-0 confirmation scoring of both structures, which the qualification rule needs; 900 episodes (300 probe + 600 confirmation), under the 1100 ceiling. Fitting seeds vary minibatch order only (R-004 found data variation adds little at bank level).

verdicts.reasoning: Child minus identically refitted parent is +0.104, placement-level 95% [+0.023, +0.185] and seed-level [+0.083, +0.125], 5/0/0 over fit seeds: the predicted +0.05 is met and both lower bounds are above zero. The child reached 1.00 on 50 fresh cases under every seed while the parent stayed at 0.88-0.92, so the advantage does not depend on one fit. It also meets the unchanged qualification rule (0.00 untrained, 1.00 fitted in all seeds). Caveat: seeds vary minibatch order only, and this is one structure on one task.
verdicts.next_experiment: Decide (user or delegated advisor) whether to admit gen0_cand5_a0 to the fittable seed bank as a fittable_seed; then test whether geometry-scope mutation transfers to other parents (R-012).
